scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm run test:launcher && npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.test:browser: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix frontend run test:browser
scripts.format: frontend/node_modules/.bin/prettier --write server/src server/test/*.ts server/package.json server/tsconfig.json package.json && npm --prefix frontend run format
scripts.format:check: frontend/node_modules/.bin/prettier --check server/src server/test/*.ts server/package.json server/tsconfig.json package.json && npm --prefix frontend run format:check
